Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
Honestly: if the “pricier” one is the LED upgrade, it’s only worth it if you’ll actually use the built-in light/mirror a lot—otherwise it’s more convenience than lash-value.
For pure bang-for-buck results, the cheaper standard Control Kit setup is totally fine (same core system), then you can put the extra budget toward refills as you go.

On a tight budget, I’d personally pick the Pre-Mapped Control Kit—it’s the lowest buy-in for a full “get started” setup, and you get both Natural + Volume so you can try two vibes right away.
If you want more customization (more lash style/length options), go with the Lashify Control Kit - v3, but it’s more upfront.
